{"id":533077369,"iid":3928,"project_id":34675721,"title":"feat(df): add go module proxy matcher","description":"Adds `GoMatcher`, the proxy classifier for the Go module ecosystem, following the precedent of the merged npm/pypi/gem/maven matchers and the cargo (!3890) and nuget matchers.

The matcher recognizes module **zip downloads** served by a module proxy (`.../{module}/@v/{version}.zip`) and maps them to their exact module coordinate. The wire path is bang-decoded back to canonical form (a `!x` sequence on the wire means uppercase `X`), and version-suffixed module paths are handled through the standard module path.

Metadata and index requests (`.info`, `.mod`, `@latest`, `/@v/list`) pass through untouched. A recognized-but-unparseable zip download (empty module path or version) fails closed via the `unparseableMatch` helper. Blocked Go fetches use the default plain-text 403 block body.

Scoped to the `internal/dependencyfirewall/proxy` package. Stacked on the nuget matcher branch
